name: HIPL — Hinduism in Public Life
description: HIPL is a modern ideas platform for Hindu thought: public debates, long conversations, a sourced library, seva and gatherings, and the questions people have always wanted to ask.

announcement.text: Saturday 31 October · The launch of HIPL and our first debate, with the Delhi Union · Constitution Club of India, New Delhi

hero.verse_translation: Truth is one; the wise call it by many names.
hero.lede: HIPL is a modern ideas platform for Hindu thought. Ask anything, argue well: in public debates, long conversations, a sourced library and seva on the ground, because questioning has always been part of the tradition.
floating_questions: Can the state run a temple?

ticker: Should the Constitution regulate Hindu temples?
Can tradition evolve without losing its essence?
Is Hinduism a religion, a philosophy or a way of life?
Can Hindu society confront caste honestly?
What do people my age actually believe?
working_test: Does it strengthen the language, deepen the faith, build the country?
